get.description: Lists persisted AI execution tasks for one catalog draft. Tasks pin an immutable catalog input version.

200.description: Latest tasks

post.description: Creates a queued execution record only; it does not itself call a model. If-Match pins the exact catalog draft version. Runtime worker leases, budget reservations, retries and UNKNOWN reconciliation are internal execution contracts.

201.description: Persisted queued task; no model execution implied

get.description: Returns task state, immutable input identity, budget/cost, attempts and immutable artifact versions. Lease tokens and provider request keys are never exposed.

200.description: Agent task
